executeUtilityAgent.description:
🤖 Execute the Utility Agents Supervisor!

The supervisor has a team of specialized Standard Agents that can perform complex tasks beyond your knowledge.

Use when the user asks for:
- "research", "investigate", "analyze in depth"
- "market analysis", "competitor analysis"
- "generate report", "create document"
- "consult the agent", "use the agent"

Simply describe what you need in natural language.

params.user_input: Natural language description of what the agent should do

searchArtifacts.description:
Search for artifacts in the current namespace.
Artifacts are documents, templates, configs saved in MCP.

Use when the user asks to:
- Search, look for, find artifacts
- View templates or patterns
- List documents by term

listArtifacts.description:
List all available artifacts in the namespace.
Returns the first 20 artifacts with their keys and types.

readArtifact.description:
Read the content of a specific artifact.
Use after searching or listing to view details of an artifact.

createArtifact.description:
Create a new artifact in MCP.
Artifacts are documents, templates, configs that can be reused.

Use when the user wants to save something in the namespace.

params.key: Unique key for the artifact (e.g., TEMPLATE_REPORT_V1)

captureFeedback.description:
Capture user feedback intelligently. Analyzes the message to determine category and severity.

Available categories: {{categories}}

params.title: Brief feedback title (max 100 chars)
params.severity: Severity level: critical (system down), high (major impact), medium (moderate), low (minor)
params.impact: Impact scope: individual (one user), team (multiple users), department (department-wide), organization (company-wide)

quickBugReport.description: Quick action to report a bug or problem. Use when the user mentions error, problem, or something not working.

suggestFeature.description: Action to suggest a new feature or improvement. Use when the user has an idea or suggestion.

params.suggestion: What is the suggestion or idea?

shareSuccess.description: Action to share a success story or positive experience. Use when the user mentions something that worked well.

params.success: What was the success or positive experience?
params.impact: What was the impact of this success?

rateAgentResponse.description: Action to rate or give feedback about an AI agent response. Use when user mentions the agent helped or didn't help, or comments on response quality.

params.agentName: Name of the agent if known

askQuestion.description: Action to register a doubt or question that needs clarification. Use when the user has a question.

params.question: What is the doubt or question?

shareInsight.description: Action to share an insight, discovery, or important observation. Use when the user has a learning.

params.insight: What is the insight or discovery?
params.implication: What is the implication or consequence of this insight?

reportError.description: Action to report a runtime error or exception. Use when the user mentions a runtime error or exception.

params.context: What were you doing when the error occurred?

listSignals.description:
List recent signals (insights, feedbacks, alerts).
Use to see what was captured in Atlas.

params.type: Filter by type: insight, feedback, message, or all

listFeedbacks.description:
List all feedbacks from the Feedback Hub with visual UI.
Can filter by status, category, severity, or source.

Status: new, acknowledged, in_progress, resolved, wont_fix
Categories: bug, feature, agent, tool, workflow, learning, success
Severities: critical, high, medium, low
Sources: upstream, downstream, migration, onboarding, general

getFeedbackStatistics.description:
Get detailed statistics about all feedbacks.
Returns counts by status, category, severity, and source.

navigateToPage.description:
Navigate to a page or module of the system.
Use when the user asks to go somewhere.

Available modules:
- dashboard: Home page
- upstream: Discovery/Ideation module (BV Framework)
- downstream: Delivery/Implementation module
- migration: Artifact Migration Wizard
- onboarding: Training and Onboarding
- atlas: Signals and Insights Hub (Feedback Hub)
- messages: Message Box
- settings: System settings

params.destination: The destination: dashboard, upstream, downstream, migration, onboarding, atlas, messages, settings

createSignal.description:
Create a new Signal in Atlas.
Signals are knowledge units: insights, feedbacks, or alerts.

Use when the user shares:
- A discovery or pattern (insight)
- A risk, alert, or note (message)

TYPES:
- insight: Discoveries, patterns, opportunities
- message: Alerts, notes, risks

CATEGORIES:
- insight: discovery, pattern, opportunity, innovation, risk
- message: alert, note, risk

PRIORITIES: low, medium, high, critical

params.category: Category: discovery, pattern, opportunity, risk, innovation, note, alert
params.title: Short and descriptive title (max 100 chars)

createTask.description:
Create a new personal task for the user.
Tasks are private and visible only to the user.

Use when the user:
- Asks to create, add, note a task
- Mentions something they need to do or remember
- Wants to register a TODO or reminder

ALWAYS confirm creation showing title, priority, and status.

params.title: Task title (required)
params.priority: Priority: low, medium, high, critical. Default: medium
params.status: Initial status: backlog, todo (default), in_progress, review, done
params.dueDate: Due date in ISO format (e.g., 2024-12-31). Optional.

listMyTasks.description:
List the user's personal tasks.
Shows all tasks or filters by status.

Use when the user asks to:
- View, list, show tasks
- See what they have to do
- View backlog, pending, in progress, etc.

params.status: Filter by status: backlog, todo, in_progress, review, done, all (default)

completeTask.description:
Mark a task as completed.

Use when the user:
- Says they finished, completed a task
- Asks to mark as done

params.taskTitle: Title or part of the title of the task to search and complete

moveTask.description:
Move a task to another status/column.

Use when the user:
- Asks to move task to another status
- Starts working on a task (move to in_progress)
- Puts in review, backlog, etc.

params.taskTitle: Title or part of the title of the task
params.newStatus: New status: backlog, todo, in_progress, review, done

deleteTask.description:
Delete a task permanently.

Use when the user asks to:
- Delete, remove a task
- Clean up old tasks

params.taskTitle: Title or part of the title of the task to delete

summarizeDay.description:
Generate a summary of the day with priority tasks and suggestions.

Use when the user:
- Asks "what do I have to do today?"
- Requests day summary, planning, priorities
- Asks where to start
- Says "good morning" or starts the work day

getTaskInsights.description:
Analyze tasks and provide proactive insights and suggestions.

Use when the user:
- Asks for analysis, insights, or suggestions about tasks
- Asks what is blocked or stuck
- Wants to know how to improve productivity

createContextualTask.description:
Create a task automatically based on the current module context.

Use when the user:
- Is working in a module and wants to create related task
- Asks to "note this" or "remember this" while working
- Wants to create task from what they're doing

kanban_getBoardOverview.description: Get an overview of the Kanban board with item counts per column. Shows the current state of all feedbacks across: Inbox (new items), Acknowledged (being reviewed), In Progress (being worked on), Resolved (completed), Won't Fix (declined). Use this to understand the current workload and identify bottlenecks.

kanban_moveFeedback.description: Move a feedback to a different Kanban column (change its status). Valid transitions: new → acknowledged (start reviewing), acknowledged → in_progress (start working), in_progress → resolved (complete the work), Any status → wont_fix (decline/close). Examples: 'Move feedback fb-123 to in progress', 'Mark the first critical bug as acknowledged', 'Resolve the feedback about login issues'

params.feedbackId: ID of the feedback to move

kanban_getColumnItems.description: Get all feedbacks in a specific Kanban column. Use this to: See what's in the inbox, Check what's currently in progress, Review resolved items. Examples: 'What's in the inbox?', 'Show me items in progress', 'List all resolved feedbacks'

params.column: Which column to get items from

kanban_bulkTransition.description: Move multiple feedbacks at once. Useful for: Moving all items from inbox to acknowledged, Resolving multiple items at once, Bulk declining feedbacks. Examples: 'Move all critical bugs to in progress', 'Acknowledge all new feedbacks from upstream', 'Resolve all low priority items'

params.filter: Optional filter: { severity?: string, category?: string, source?: string }
params.maxItems: Maximum items to move (safety limit, default: 5)

kanban_suggestNextAction.description: Get AI suggestion for the next action on the Kanban board. Analyzes the current state and recommends what to focus on. Examples: 'What should I work on next?', 'Suggest next action', 'What's most urgent?'

add_feedback_comment.description: Add a comment to a feedback as the AI assistant. Use this to: Share analysis findings with the team, Make recommendations for resolution, Ask questions or request clarification, Document important observations, Explain status changes. The comment will be visible in the feedback's activity timeline.

params.feedbackId: ID of the feedback to comment on
params.commentType: Type of comment: analysis (findings), recommendation (suggestions), status_change (explaining transitions), question (requesting info), general (other)

comment_and_move_feedback.description: Add a comment explaining why a feedback should be moved, then move it to a new column. This combines documentation with action - always use this instead of just moving when there's context to share. Best for: Explaining why you're closing something as won't fix, Documenting resolution when marking as resolved, Noting blockers when moving back to acknowledged, Recording triage decisions

params.reason: Explanation for the transition (will be added as a comment)

read_feedback_comments.description: Read the comments on a feedback to understand its history and context. Use this before: Making recommendations (to see what was already suggested), Answering questions (to see if they were already answered), Adding analysis (to avoid repeating findings)

params.feedbackId: ID of the feedback to read comments from

read_feedback_history.description: Read the status transition history of a feedback. Use this to: Understand how long items have been in each status, Identify stale or blocked items, See who made changes and why

check_related_feedbacks.description: Check for feedbacks related to this one. Shows duplicates, blockers, and related issues. Use before suggesting changes to understand dependencies.

analyzePatterns.description: Analyze feedback patterns to identify recurring issues, common themes, and areas that need attention. This helps administrators understand what's working and what needs improvement across all modules.

params.timeframe: Time period to analyze (last_24h, last_week, last_month, all_time)
params.focusArea: Which category to focus on (bugs, questions, suggestions, all)

generateReport.description: Generate a comprehensive summary report of the feedback status. This can be used for stakeholder updates or team meetings.

findSimilar.description: Find feedbacks that are similar or potentially duplicates of a given feedback. This helps consolidate related issues and avoid duplicate work.

params.feedbackId: ID of the feedback to find similar items for

suggestPriorities.description: Analyze pending feedbacks and suggest a priority order for addressing them. Takes into account severity, age, and category.

params.limit: Maximum number of items to prioritize (default: 10)

resolveFeedback.description: Mark a feedback as resolved with a resolution note.

params.feedbackId: ID of the feedback to resolve

updateStatus.description: Update the status of a feedback item.

suggestResolution.description: Suggest a resolution approach for a feedback item based on similar past issues.

listFeedbacks.description: List feedbacks with optional filters for status and category.

params.status: Filter by status (new, in_progress, resolved, wont_fix, all)

getFeedbackDetails.description: Get detailed information about a specific feedback including all metadata and history.

listComments.description: List all comments for a feedback item.

captureFeedback.description: Capture and save a new feedback from the conversation. Use when user reports an issue or suggestion.

getKanbanBoard.description: Get the current kanban board state with all columns and feedbacks organized by status.

moveFeedbackColumn.description: Move a feedback to a different kanban column/status.

deepAnalysis.description: Trigger deep AI analysis of feedbacks using LangGraph agents for advanced pattern detection.

params.analysisType: Type of analysis to perform (patterns, sentiment, priorities, full)

deepPatterns.description: Use DeepAgent to identify complex patterns across all feedbacks with advanced AI capabilities.

deep_analyze.description:
Run a deep analysis on feedback data using AI agents.
This uses advanced pattern detection and subagents to:
- Detect patterns across multiple feedbacks
- Identify root causes
- Suggest resolution priorities
- Generate comprehensive reports

Examples:
- "Analyze all bug reports from this week"
- "Find patterns in user complaints"
- "What are the most critical issues?"
- "Generate a report on feedback trends"

params.query: The analysis query or question to investigate
params.includeReport: Whether to generate a formatted report

analyze_feedback.description:
Analyze a specific feedback item using the LangGraph agent.
This runs a structured analysis pipeline:
1. Category and severity detection
2. Duplicate checking
3. Priority calculation
4. Resolution suggestions

The analysis will be saved as a comment on the feedback for future reference.
Use this for detailed analysis of individual feedbacks.

params.feedbackId: The ID of the feedback to analyze (required to save analysis as comment)
params.title: Title or summary of the feedback
params.feedbackType: Type of feedback (bug, feature, improvement, question)
